examples.text: He was my sponsor when I applied to join the club.

glosses: A person or organization with some sort of responsibility for another person or organization, especially where the responsibility has a religious, legal, or financial aspect.

glosses: A person or organization that pays all or part of the cost of an event, publication, media program, etc., usually in exchange for advertising.

glosses: To be a sponsor for.

examples.text: Like most human activities, ballooning has sponsored heroes and hucksters and a good deal in between. glosses: Devenir le parrain d’une personne ou de quelque chose ; lui apporter son soutien.

examples.text: En revanche nombreux sont ceux, élus locaux, hommes politiques, et institutions qui parrainent ouvertement les enfants et des familles menacés d’expulsion.
